## Constants[§](https://docs.rs#constants)

- [AABB_](https://docs.rs/constant.AABB_GEOMETRY_MIN_STRIDE.html)- GEOMETRY_ - MIN_ - STRIDE
- Minimum stride for AABB geometry (24 bytes: two `vec3<f32>`). Minimum stride for AABB geometry (24 bytes: two`vec3<f32>`).
- [COPY_](https://docs.rs/constant.COPY_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT.html)- BUFFER_ - ALIGNMENT
- Buffer to buffer copy as well as buffer clear offsets and sizes must be aligned to this number.
- [COPY_](https://docs.rs/constant.COPY_BYTES_PER_ROW_ALIGNMENT.html)- BYTES_ - PER_ - ROW_ - ALIGNMENT
- Buffer-texture copies must have `bytes_per_row`
- [IMMEDIATE_](https://docs.rs/constant.IMMEDIATE_DATA_ALIGNMENT.html)- DATA_ - ALIGNMENT
- Ranges of [writes to immediate data](https://docs.rs/wgpu/struct.RenderPass.html#method.set_immediates)must be at least this aligned.
- [MAP_](https://docs.rs/constant.MAP_ALIGNMENT.html)- ALIGNMENT
- Minimum alignment of buffer mappings.
- [MAXIMUM_](https://docs.rs/constant.MAXIMUM_SUBGROUP_MAX_SIZE.html)- SUBGROUP_ - MAX_ - SIZE
- The maximum allowed value for `AdapterInfo::subgroup_max_size`
- [MINIMUM_](https://docs.rs/constant.MINIMUM_SUBGROUP_MIN_SIZE.html)- SUBGROUP_ - MIN_ - SIZE
- The minimum allowed value for `AdapterInfo::subgroup_min_size`
- [QUERY_](https://docs.rs/constant.QUERY_RESOLVE_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT.html)- RESOLVE_ - BUFFER_ - ALIGNMENT
- An [offset into the query resolve buffer](https://docs.rs/wgpu/struct.CommandEncoder.html#method.resolve_query_set)has to be aligned to this.
- [QUERY_](https://docs.rs/constant.QUERY_SET_MAX_QUERIES.html)- SET_ - MAX_ - QUERIES
- Maximum number of query result slots that can be requested in a `QuerySetDescriptor`
- [QUERY_](https://docs.rs/constant.QUERY_SIZE.html)- SIZE
- Size in bytes of a single piece of [query](https://docs.rs/wgpu/struct.QuerySet.html)data.
- [VERTEX_](https://docs.rs/constant.VERTEX_ALIGNMENT.html)- ALIGNMENT
- [Vertex buffer offsets](https://docs.rs/wgpu/util/trait.RenderEncoder.html#tymethod.set_vertex_buffer)and- [strides](https://docs.rs/wgpu/struct.VertexBufferLayout.html#structfield.array_stride)have to be a multiple of this number.
- [VERTEX_](https://docs.rs/constant.VERTEX_STRIDE_ALIGNMENT.html)- STRIDE_ - ALIGNMENT - Deprecated
- [Vertex buffer strides](https://docs.rs/wgpu/struct.VertexBufferLayout.html#structfield.array_stride)have to be a multiple of this number.

## Modules[§](https://docs.rs#modules)

## Macros[§](https://docs.rs#macros)

## Traits[§](https://docs.rs#traits)

- [A11y](https://docs.rs/trait.A11yBridge.html)- Bridge
- Bridge from Repose’s semantics tree to platform accessibility APIs.

## Functions[§](https://docs.rs#functions)

- [compose_](https://docs.rs/fn.compose_frame.html)- frame
- Compose a single frame with density and text-scale applied, returning Frame.
- [hide_](https://docs.rs/fn.hide_app_window.html)- app_ - window
- [push_](https://docs.rs/fn.push_deeplink.html)- deeplink
- Push a deeplink payload from any thread (JNI callback, CLI watcher, etc).
- [run_](https://docs.rs/fn.run_desktop_app.html)- desktop_ - app
- [set_](https://docs.rs/fn.set_about_to_wait_callback.html)- about_ - to_ - wait_ - callback
- Register a callback invoked on every AboutToWait (used for draining tray commands).
- [set_](https://docs.rs/fn.set_app_window.html)- app_ - window
- Store the application window handle (called once during app setup).
- [set_](https://docs.rs/fn.set_close_to_tray.html)- close_ - to_ - tray
- The close button hides the window (via `set_visible(false)`) instead of closing. The tray “Quit” action still exits the process regardless.
- [set_](https://docs.rs/fn.set_event_loop_proxy.html)- event_ - loop_ - proxy
- Store the event loop proxy so tray commands / deeplinks can wake the event loop.
- [set_](https://docs.rs/fn.set_on_deeplink.html)- on_ - deeplink
- Register a callback to receive deeplink payloads (raw bytes)
- [show_](https://docs.rs/fn.show_app_window.html)- app_ - window
- Show the application window.
- [tf_](https://docs.rs/fn.tf_ensure_visible_in_rect.html)- ensure_ - visible_ - in_ - rect
- Helper: ensure caret visibility for a TextFieldState inside a given rect (px).
- [wake_](https://docs.rs/fn.wake_event_loop.html)- event_ - loop
- Wake the winit event loop from another thread (e.g. tray’s GTK thread, JNI callback).
- [window_](https://docs.rs/fn.window_is_visible.html)- is_ - visible
- Returns whether the application window is currently visible.

[77](#77)pub(crate) fn process_deeplinks() {
[80](#80)    let mut queue = PENDING_DEEPLINKS.lock().unwrap();
[81](#81)    if queue.is_empty() {
[82](#82)        return;
[83](#83)    }
[84](#84)    let batch = std::mem::take(&mut *queue);
[85](#85)    drop(queue);
[86](#86)
[87](#87)    if let Some(cb) = DEEPLINK_CB.lock().unwrap().as_ref() {
[88](#88)        for data in batch {
[89](#89)            cb(data);
[90](#90)        }
[91](#91)    }

[160](#160)pub fn compose_frame<F>(
[162](#162)    sched: &mut Scheduler,
[163](#163)    root_fn: &mut F,
[164](#164)    scale: f32,
[165](#165)    size_px_u32: (u32, u32),
[166](#166)    hover_id: Option<u64>,
[167](#167)    pressed_ids: &std::collections::HashSet<u64>,
[168](#168)    tf_states: &std::collections::HashMap<u64, Rc<RefCell<repose_ui::TextFieldState>>>,
[169](#169)    _focused: Option<u64>,
[170](#170)) -> Frame
[171](#171)where
[172](#172)    F: FnMut(&mut Scheduler) -> View,
[173](#173){
[174](#174)    if let Some(requested_id) = repose_core::take_focus_request() {
[176](#176)        if requested_id == repose_core::runtime::CLEAR_FOCUS_MARKER {
[177](#177)            sched.focused = None;
[178](#178)        } else {
[179](#179)            sched.focused = Some(requested_id);
[180](#180)        }
[181](#181)    }
[182](#182)
[183](#183)    set_density_default(Density { scale });
[184](#184)
[185](#185)    let current_focused = sched.focused;
[187](#187)
[188](#188)    let frame = sched.repose(
[189](#189)        {
[190](#190)            let scale = scale;
[191](#191)            move |s: &mut Scheduler| with_density(Density { scale }, || (root_fn)(s))
[192](#192)        },
[193](#193)        {
[194](#194)            let hover_id = hover_id;
[195](#195)            let pressed_ids = pressed_ids.clone();
[196](#196)            move |view, _size| {
[197](#197)                let interactions = repose_ui::Interactions {
[198](#198)                    hover: hover_id,
[199](#199)                    pressed: pressed_ids.clone(),
[200](#200)                };
[201](#201)
[202](#202)                with_density(Density { scale }, || {
[203](#203)                    repose_ui::layout_and_paint(
[204](#204)                        view,
[205](#205)                        size_px_u32,
[206](#206)                        tf_states,
[207](#207)                        &interactions,
[208](#208)                        current_focused,
[209](#209)                    )
[210](#210)                })
[211](#211)            }
[212](#212)        },
[213](#213)    );
[214](#214)
[215](#215)    if let Some(fid) = sched.focused {
[216](#216)        if !frame.focus_chain.contains(&fid) {
[217](#217)            sched.focused = None;
[218](#218)        }
[219](#219)    }
[220](#220)
[221](#221)    frame
[222](#222)}
[223](#223)
[224](#224)pub fn tf_ensure_visible_in_rect(state: &mut repose_ui::TextFieldState, inner_rect: Rect) {
[226](#226)    let font_px = dp_to_px(TF_FONT_DP) * repose_core::locals::text_scale().0;
[227](#227)    let m = measure_text(&state.text, font_px, None, 400, 0);
[228](#228)    let caret_x_px = m.positions.get(state.caret_index()).copied().unwrap_or(0.0);
[229](#229)    state.ensure_caret_visible(
[230](#230)        caret_x_px,
[231](#231)        inner_rect.w - 2.0 * dp_to_px(TF_PADDING_X_DP),
[232](#232)        dp_to_px(2.0),
[233](#233)    );
[234](#234)}
[235](#235)
[236](#236)#[cfg(all(not(target_os = "android"), not(target_arch = "wasm32")))]
[237](#237)fn map_cursor(c: repose_core::CursorIcon) -> winit::window::CursorIcon {
[238](#238)    use winit::window::CursorIcon as W;
[239](#239)    match c {
[240](#240)        repose_core::CursorIcon::Default => W::Default,
[241](#241)        repose_core::CursorIcon::Pointer => W::Pointer,
[242](#242)        repose_core::CursorIcon::Text => W::Text,
[243](#243)        repose_core::CursorIcon::EwResize => W::EwResize,
[244](#244)        repose_core::CursorIcon::NsResize => W::NsResize,
[245](#245)        repose_core::CursorIcon::Grab => W::Grab,
[246](#246)        repose_core::CursorIcon::Grabbing => W::Grabbing,
[247](#247)    }
[248](#248)}

[282](#282)    struct App {

[309](#309)        last_focus: Option<u64>,
[310](#310)

[322](#322)    impl App {
[323](#323)        fn process_a11y_actions(&mut self) {
[324](#324)            let mut actions = self.a11y_actions.lock().unwrap();
[325](#325)            if actions.is_empty() {
[326](#326)                return;
[327](#327)            }
[328](#328)            let pending = actions.drain(..).collect::<Vec<_>>();
[329](#329)            drop(actions);
[330](#330)
[331](#331)            let Some(f) = &self.frame_cache else {
[332](#332)                return;
[333](#333)            };
[334](#334)
[335](#335)            for req in pending {
[336](#336)                let target_id = req.target_node.0;
[337](#337)                match req.action {
[338](#338)                    accesskit::Action::Click => {
[339](#339)                        if let Some(hit) = f.hit_regions.iter().find(|h| h.id == target_id)
[340](#340)                            && let Some(cb) = &hit.on_click
[341](#341)                        {
[342](#342)                            cb();
[343](#343)                            self.request_redraw();
[344](#344)                        }
[345](#345)                    }
[346](#346)                    accesskit::Action::Focus => {
[347](#347)                        self.sched.focused = Some(target_id);
[348](#348)                        self.request_redraw();
[349](#349)                    }
[350](#350)                    _ => {}
[351](#351)                }
[352](#352)            }
[353](#353)        }
[354](#354)
[355](#355)        fn new(root: Box<dyn FnMut(&mut Scheduler, &RenderContext) -> View>) -> Self {
[356](#356)            Self {
[357](#357)                root,
[358](#358)                render: RenderContext::new(),
[359](#359)                window: None,
[360](#360)                backend: None,
[361](#361)                sched: Scheduler::new(),
[362](#362)                inspector: repose_devtools::Inspector::new(),
[363](#363)                frame_cache: None,
[364](#364)                mouse_pos_px: (0.0, 0.0),
[365](#365)                modifiers: Modifiers::default(),
[366](#366)                textfield_states: HashMap::new(),
[367](#367)                ime_preedit: false,
[368](#368)                hover_id: None,
[369](#369)                capture_id: None,
[370](#370)                pressed_ids: HashSet::new(),
[371](#371)                pending_dropped_files: Vec::new(),
[372](#372)                pending_drop_pos_px: None,
[373](#373)
[374](#374)                external_file_drag: false,
[375](#375)                hovered_files: Vec::new(),
[376](#376)
[377](#377)                key_pressed_active: None,
[378](#378)                clipboard: None,
[379](#379)                a11y: {
[380](#380)                    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
[381](#381)                    {
[382](#382)                        Box::new(LinuxAtspiStub) as Box<dyn A11yBridge>
[383](#383)                    }
[384](#384)                    #[cfg(not(target_os = "linux"))]
[385](#385)                    {
[386](#386)                        Box::new(NoopA11y) as Box<dyn A11yBridge>
[387](#387)                    }
[388](#388)                },
[389](#389)                last_focus: None,
[390](#390)
[391](#391)                accesskit_adapter: None,
[392](#392)                a11y_actions: Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new())),
[393](#393)                a11y_tree: A11yTree::default(),
[394](#394)
[395](#395)                last_redraw: Instant::now(),
[396](#396)                pending_redraw: false,
[397](#397)                redraw_requested: Cell::new(false),
[398](#398)            }
[399](#399)        }

[401](#401)        fn request_redraw(&self) {

[405](#405)        }

[411](#411)
[412](#412)        fn paste_from_primary(&self) -> Option<String> {
[413](#413)            let opts = clipawl::ClipboardOptions {
[414](#414)                linux: clipawl::LinuxOptions {
[415](#415)                    selection: clipawl::LinuxSelection::Primary,
[416](#416)                    ..Default::default()
[417](#417)                },
[418](#418)            };
[419](#419)            if let Ok(cb) = clipawl::Clipboard::new_with_options(opts) {
[420](#420)                match pollster::block_on(cb.read()) {
[421](#421)                    Ok(t) => Some(t),
[422](#422)                    Err(e) => {
[423](#423)                        eprintln!("Primary paste error: {}", e);
[424](#424)                        None
[425](#425)                    }
[426](#426)                }
[427](#427)            } else {
[428](#428)                None
[429](#429)            }
[430](#430)        }
[431](#431)
[432](#432)        fn process_render_commands(&mut self) {
[433](#433)            let Some(backend) = self.backend.as_mut() else {
[434](#434)                return;
[435](#435)            };
[436](#436)            rc::process_render_commands(backend, self.render.drain());
[437](#437)        }

[439](#439)        fn reset_pointer_state(&mut self) {

[443](#443)        }

[447](#447)        }
[448](#448)
[449](#449)        fn is_multiline_id(&self, id: u64) -> bool {
[450](#450)            if let Some(f) = &self.frame_cache {
[451](#451)                f.hit_regions
[452](#452)                    .iter()
[453](#453)                    .find(|h| h.id == id)
[454](#454)                    .map(|h| h.tf_multiline)
[455](#455)                    .unwrap_or(false)
[456](#456)            } else {
[457](#457)                false
[458](#458)            }
[459](#459)        }
[460](#460)
[461](#461)        fn hit_by_id(f: &Frame, id: u64) -> Option<&HitRegion> {
[462](#462)            f.hit_regions.iter().find(|h| h.id == id)
[463](#463)        }

[474](#474)    impl ApplicationHandler<()> for App {
[475](#475)        fn resumed(&mut self, el: &winit::event_loop::ActiveEventLoop) {
[476](#476)            self.clipboard = clipawl::Clipboard::new()
[477](#477)                .map_err(|e| {
[478](#478)                    eprintln!("clipawl clipboard init failed: {e}");
[479](#479)                    e
[480](#480)                })
[481](#481)                .ok();
[482](#482)            repose_core::clipboard::set_clipboard_read_fn(Box::new(|| {
[483](#483)                clipawl::blocking::read().ok()
[484](#484)            }));
[485](#485)            repose_core::clipboard::set_clipboard_fn(Box::new(move |text| {
[487](#487)                if let Err(e) = clipawl::blocking::write(text) {
[488](#488)                    eprintln!("clipboard write error: {e}");
[489](#489)                }
[490](#490)            }));
[491](#491)
[492](#492)            repose_core::clipboard::set_primary_fn(Box::new(|text| {
[493](#493)                let opts = clipawl::ClipboardOptions {
[494](#494)                    linux: clipawl::LinuxOptions {
[495](#495)                        selection: clipawl::LinuxSelection::Primary,
[496](#496)                        ..Default::default()
[497](#497)                    },
[498](#498)                };
[499](#499)                match clipawl::Clipboard::new_with_options(opts) {
[500](#500)                    Ok(cb) => {
[501](#501)                        if let Err(e) = pollster::block_on(cb.write(text)) {
[502](#502)                            eprintln!("primary selection write error: {e}");
[503](#503)                        }
[504](#504)                    }
[505](#505)                    Err(e) => eprintln!("primary clipboard init error: {e}"),
[506](#506)                }
[507](#507)            }));
[508](#508)
[509](#509)            if self.window.is_none() {
[510](#510)                match el.create_window(
[511](#511)                    WindowAttributes::default()
[512](#512)                        .with_title("Repose")
[513](#513)                        .with_inner_size(PhysicalSize::new(1280, 800))
[514](#514)                        .with_visible(false),
[515](#515)                ) {
[516](#516)                    Ok(win) => {
[517](#517)                        let w = Arc::new(win);
[518](#518)
[519](#519)                        let activation_handler = ReposeActivationHandler {
[520](#520)                            initial_tree: Some(A11yTree::initial_tree()),
[521](#521)                        };
[522](#522)
[523](#523)                        let action_handler = ReposeActionHandler {
[524](#524)                            pending_actions: self.a11y_actions.clone(),
[525](#525)                        };
[526](#526)
[527](#527)                        let deactivation_handler = ReposeDeactivationHandler;
[528](#528)
[529](#529)                        let adapter = Adapter::with_direct_handlers(
[530](#530)                            el,
[531](#531)                            &w,
[532](#532)                            activation_handler,
[533](#533)                            action_handler,
[534](#534)                            deactivation_handler,
[535](#535)                        );
[536](#536)
[537](#537)                        self.accesskit_adapter = Some(adapter);
[538](#538)
[539](#539)                        w.set_visible(true);
[540](#540)
[541](#541)                        let size = w.inner_size();
[542](#542)                        self.sched.size = (size.width, size.height);
[543](#543)
[544](#544)                        match repose_render_wgpu::WgpuBackend::new(w.clone()) {
[545](#545)                            Ok(b) => {
[546](#546)                                self.backend = Some(b);
[547](#547)                                set_app_window(w.clone());
[548](#548)                                self.window = Some(w);
[549](#549)                                self.request_redraw();
[550](#550)                            }
[551](#551)                            Err(e) => {
[552](#552)                                log::error!("Failed to create WGPU backend: {e:?}");
[553](#553)                                el.exit();
[554](#554)                            }
[555](#555)                        }
[556](#556)                    }
[557](#557)                    Err(e) => {
[558](#558)                        log::error!("Failed to create window: {e:?}");
[559](#559)                        el.exit();
[560](#560)                    }
[561](#561)                }
[562](#562)            }
[563](#563)        }
[564](#564)
[565](#565)        fn window_event(
[566](#566)            &mut self,
[567](#567)            el: &winit::event_loop::ActiveEventLoop,
[568](#568)            _id: winit::window::WindowId,
[569](#569)            event: WindowEvent,
[570](#570)        ) {
[571](#571)            if let Some(adapter) = &mut self.accesskit_adapter {
[573](#573)                adapter.process_event(self.window.as_ref().unwrap(), &event);
[574](#574)            }
[575](#575)
[576](#576)            match event {
[577](#577)                WindowEvent::CloseRequested => {
[578](#578)                    if CLOSE_TO_TRAY.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
[579](#579)                        self.backend = None;
[581](#581)                        if let Some(w) = &self.window {
[582](#582)                            w.set_visible(false);
[583](#583)                        }
[584](#584)                        WINDOW_VISIBLE.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
[585](#585)                    } else {
[586](#586)                        el.exit();
[587](#587)                    }
[588](#588)                }
[589](#589)
[590](#590)                WindowEvent::Focused(false) => {
[591](#591)                    repose_core::dnd::handle_drag_action(
[593](#593)                        &repose_core::shortcuts::DragAction::Cancel,
[594](#594)                    );
[595](#595)
[596](#596)                    if let (Some(f), Some(cid)) = (&self.frame_cache, self.capture_id) {
[598](#598)                        if let Some(hit) = f.hit_regions.iter().find(|h| h.id == cid) {
[599](#599)                            if let Some(cb) = &hit.on_pointer_cancel {
[600](#600)                                let pos = repose_core::Vec2 {
[601](#601)                                    x: self.mouse_pos_px.0,
[602](#602)                                    y: self.mouse_pos_px.1,
[603](#603)                                };
[604](#604)                                let pe = PointerEvent::new(
[605](#605)                                    PointerId(0),
[606](#606)                                    PointerKind::Mouse,
[607](#607)                                    PointerEventKind::Cancel,
[608](#608)                                    pos,
[609](#609)                                    1.0,
[610](#610)                                    self.modifiers,
[611](#611)                                );
[612](#612)                                cb(pe);
[613](#613)                            }
[614](#614)                        }
[615](#615)                    }
[616](#616)
[617](#617)                    self.external_file_drag = false;
[619](#619)                    self.hovered_files.clear();
[620](#620)                    self.reset_pointer_state();
[621](#621)
[622](#622)                    if let Some(w) = &self.window {
[623](#623)                        rc_web::set_ime_for_textfield(w, false);
[624](#624)                    }
[625](#625)                    self.ime_preedit = false;
[626](#626)
[627](#627)                    self.request_redraw();
[628](#628)                }
[629](#629)
[630](#630)                WindowEvent::HoveredFile(path) => {
[631](#631)                    self.external_file_drag = true;
[633](#633)                    if self.hovered_files.len() < 32 {
[634](#634)                        self.hovered_files.push(path);
[635](#635)                    }
[636](#636)                    if self.pending_drop_pos_px.is_none() {
[638](#638)                        self.pending_drop_pos_px = Some(self.mouse_pos_px);
[639](#639)                    }
[640](#640)                    self.request_redraw();
[641](#641)                }
[642](#642)
[643](#643)                WindowEvent::HoveredFileCancelled => {
[644](#644)                    self.external_file_drag = false;
[645](#645)                    self.hovered_files.clear();
[646](#646)
[647](#647)                    self.reset_pointer_state();
[649](#649)
[650](#650)                    self.request_redraw();
[651](#651)                }
[652](#652)
[653](#653)                WindowEvent::DroppedFile(path) => {
[654](#654)                    self.pending_dropped_files.push(path);
[656](#656)                    if self.pending_drop_pos_px.is_none() {
[657](#657)                        self.pending_drop_pos_px = Some(self.mouse_pos_px);
[658](#658)                    }
[659](#659)
[660](#660)                    self.external_file_drag = false;
[662](#662)                    self.hovered_files.clear();
[663](#663)
[664](#664)                    self.request_redraw();
[665](#665)                }
[666](#666)
[667](#667)                WindowEvent::Resized(size) => {
[668](#668)                    self.sched.size = (size.width, size.height);
[669](#669)                    if let Some(b) = self.backend.as_mut() {
[670](#670)                        b.configure_surface(size.width, size.height);
[671](#671)                    }
[672](#672)                    if let Some(w) = &self.window {
[673](#673)                        let sf = w.scale_factor() as f32;
[674](#674)                        let dp_w = size.width as f32 / sf;
[675](#675)                        let dp_h = size.height as f32 / sf;
[676](#676)                        log::info!(
[677](#677)                            "Resized: fb={}x{} px, scale_factor={}, ~{}x{} dp",
[678](#678)                            size.width,
[679](#679)                            size.height,
[680](#680)                            sf,
[681](#681)                            dp_w as i32,
[682](#682)                            dp_h as i32
[683](#683)                        );
[684](#684)                    }
[685](#685)                    self.request_redraw();
[686](#686)                }
[687](#687)
[688](#688)                WindowEvent::CursorMoved { position, .. } => {
[689](#689)                    self.mouse_pos_px = (position.x as f32, position.y as f32);
[690](#690)
[691](#691)                    if self.external_file_drag {
[692](#692)                        self.pending_drop_pos_px = Some(self.mouse_pos_px);
[693](#693)                    }
[694](#694)
[695](#695)                    let pos = Vec2 {
[696](#696)                        x: self.mouse_pos_px.0,
[697](#697)                        y: self.mouse_pos_px.1,
[698](#698)                    };
[699](#699)
[700](#700)                    if repose_core::dnd::handle_drag_action(
[701](#701)                        &repose_core::shortcuts::DragAction::Move {
[702](#702)                            position: pos,
[703](#703)                            modifiers: self.modifiers,
[704](#704)                        },
[705](#705)                    ) {
[706](#706)                        self.request_redraw();
[707](#707)                        return;
[708](#708)                    }
[709](#709)
[710](#710)                    if self.inspector.hud.inspector_enabled
[712](#712)                        && let Some(f) = &self.frame_cache
[713](#713)                    {
[714](#714)                        let hit = f.hit_regions.iter().find(|h| {
[715](#715)                            h.rect.contains(Vec2 {
[716](#716)                                x: self.mouse_pos_px.0,
[717](#717)                                y: self.mouse_pos_px.1,
[718](#718)                            })
[719](#719)                        });
[720](#720)                        let hover_rect = hit.map(|h| h.rect);
[721](#721)                        let hover_info = hit.and_then(|h| {
[722](#722)                            f.semantics_nodes.iter().find(|s| s.id == h.id).map(|s| {
[723](#723)                                repose_devtools::HoveredInfo {
[724](#724)                                    id: s.id,
[725](#725)                                    role: format!("{:?}", s.role),
[726](#726)                                    label: s.label.clone(),
[727](#727)                                }
[728](#728)                            })
[729](#729)                        });
[730](#730)                        self.inspector.hud.set_hovered(hover_rect, hover_info);
[731](#731)                        self.request_redraw();
[732](#732)                    }
[733](#733)
[734](#734)                    if let (Some(f), Some(cid)) = (&self.frame_cache, self.capture_id)
[736](#736)                        && self.is_textfield(cid)
[737](#737)                        && let Some(hit) = f.hit_regions.iter().find(|h| h.id == cid)
[738](#738)                    {
[739](#739)                        let key = self.tf_key_of(cid);
[740](#740)                        if let Some(state_rc) = self.textfield_states.get(&key) {
[741](#741)                            let mut st = state_rc.borrow_mut();
[742](#742)
[743](#743)                            let pad_x = dp_to_px(TF_PADDING_X_DP);
[744](#744)                            let inner_x = hit.rect.x + pad_x;
[745](#745)                            let inner_y = hit.rect.y + dp_to_px(8.0);
[746](#746)                            let inner_w = (hit.rect.w - 2.0 * pad_x).max(1.0);
[747](#747)                            let inner_h = (hit.rect.h - dp_to_px(16.0)).max(1.0);
[748](#748)
[749](#749)                            st.set_inner_width(inner_w);
[750](#750)                            st.set_inner_height(inner_h);
[751](#751)
[752](#752)                            let content_x =
[753](#753)                                (self.mouse_pos_px.0 - inner_x + st.scroll_offset).max(0.0);
[754](#754)                            let content_y =
[755](#755)                                (self.mouse_pos_px.1 - inner_y + st.scroll_offset_y).max(0.0);
[756](#756)
[757](#757)                            let font_px =
[758](#758)                                dp_to_px(TF_FONT_DP) * repose_core::locals::text_scale().0;
[759](#759)
[760](#760)                            let idx = if hit.tf_multiline {
[761](#761)                                rc::index_for_xy_bytes_vt(
[762](#762)                                    &st, font_px, inner_w, content_x, content_y,
[763](#763)                                )
[764](#764)                            } else {

# A11yBridge in repose_platform - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/repose-platform/0.21.1/repose_platform/trait.A11yBridge.html

`pub trait A11yBridge: `[Send](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/marker/trait.Send.html) {
    // Required methods
    fn [publish_tree](https://docs.rs#tymethod.publish_tree)(&mut self, nodes: &[[SemNode](https://docs.rs/repose-core/0.21.1/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/repose_core/runtime/struct.SemNode.html)]);
[focus_changed](https://docs.rs#tymethod.focus_changed)(&mut self, node: [Option](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html)<&[SemNode](https://docs.rs/repose-core/0.21.1/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/repose_core/runtime/struct.SemNode.html)>);
[announce](https://docs.rs#tymethod.announce)(&mut self, msg: &[str](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.str.html));
}## Expand description

Bridge from Repose’s semantics tree to platform accessibility APIs.

Implementations are responsible for:

- Exposing nodes to the OS (AT‑SPI, Android accessibility, etc.).
- Updating focus when `focus_changed`is called.
- Announcing transient messages (e.g. button activation) via screen readers.

## Required Methods[§](https://docs.rs#required-methods)

[Source](https://docs.rs/src/repose_platform/lib.rs.html#2055)#### fn [publish_tree](https://docs.rs#tymethod.publish_tree)(&mut self, nodes: &[[SemNode](https://docs.rs/repose-core/0.21.1/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/repose_core/runtime/struct.SemNode.html)])

[Source](https://docs.rs/src/repose_platform/lib.rs.html#2055)

## Dyn Compatibility[§](https://docs.rs#dyn-compatibility)

*In older versions of Rust, dyn compatibility was called "object safety".*

# async_trait - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/async-trait/^0.1/

## Expand description

#### Type erasure for async trait methods

The stabilization of async functions in traits in Rust 1.75 did not include
support for using traits containing async functions as `dyn Trait`. Trying
to use dyn with an async trait produces the following error:

```
error[E0038]: the trait `Trait` is not dyn compatible
 --> src/main.rs:5:22
  |
5 | pub fn make() -> Box<dyn Trait> {
  |                      ^^^^^^^^^ `Trait` is not dyn compatible
  |
note: for a trait to be dyn compatible it needs to allow building a vtable
      for more information, visit <https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/items/traits.html#dyn-compatibility>
 --> src/main.rs:2:14
  |
1 | pub trait Trait {
  |           ----- this trait is not dyn compatible...
2 |     async fn f(&self);
  |              ^ ...because method `f` is `async`
  = help: consider moving `f` to another trait
```
This crate provides an attribute macro to make async fn in traits work with dyn traits.

Please refer to [ why async fn in traits are hard](https://smallcultfollowing.com/babysteps/blog/2019/10/26/async-fn-in-traits-are-hard/) for a deeper
analysis of how this implementation differs from what the compiler and
language deliver natively.

[§](https://docs.rs#example)Example

This example implements the core of a highly effective advertising platform using async fn in a trait.

The only thing to notice here is that we write an `#[async_trait]` macro on
top of traits and trait impls that contain async fn, and then they work. We
get to have `Vec<Box<dyn Advertisement + Sync>>` or `&[&dyn Advertisement]`,
for example.

```
use async_trait::async_trait;
#[async_trait]
trait Advertisement {
    async fn run(&self);
}
struct Modal;
#[async_trait]
impl Advertisement for Modal {
    async fn run(&self) {
        self.render_fullscreen().await;
        for _ in 0..4u16 {
            remind_user_to_join_mailing_list().await;
        }
        self.hide_for_now().await;
    }
}
struct AutoplayingVideo {
    media_url: String,
}
#[async_trait]
impl Advertisement for AutoplayingVideo {
    async fn run(&self) {
        let stream = connect(&self.media_url).await;
        stream.play().await;
        // Video probably persuaded user to join our mailing list!
        Modal.run().await;
    }
}
```
[§](https://docs.rs#supported-features)Supported features

It is the intention that all features of Rust traits should work nicely with
#[async_trait], but the edge cases are numerous. Please file an issue if
you see unexpected borrow checker errors, type errors, or warnings. There is
no use of `unsafe` in the expanded code, so rest assured that if your code
compiles it can’t be that badly broken.

☑ Self by value, by reference, by mut reference, or no self;

☑ Any number of arguments, any return value;

☑ Generic type parameters and lifetime parameters;

☑ Associated types;

☑ Having async and non-async functions in the same trait;

☑ Default implementations provided by the trait;

☑ Elided lifetimes.

[§](https://docs.rs#explanation)Explanation

Async fns get transformed into methods that return `Pin<Box<dyn Future + Send + 'async_trait>>` and delegate to an async block.

For example the `impl Advertisement for AutoplayingVideo` above would be
expanded as:

```
impl Advertisement for AutoplayingVideo {
    fn run<'async_trait>(
        &'async_trait self,
    ) -> Pin<Box<dyn core::future::Future<Output = ()> + Send + 'async_trait>>
    where
        Self: Sync + 'async_trait,
    {
        Box::pin(async move {
            /* the original method body */
        })
    }
}
```
[§](https://docs.rs#non-threadsafe-futures)Non-threadsafe futures

Not all async traits need futures that are `dyn Future + Send`. To avoid
having Send and Sync bounds placed on the async trait methods, invoke the
async trait macro as `#[async_trait(?Send)]` on both the trait and the impl
blocks.

[§](https://docs.rs#elided-lifetimes)Elided lifetimes

Be aware that async fn syntax does not allow lifetime elision outside of `&`
and `&mut` references. (This is true even when not using #[async_trait].)
Lifetimes must be named or marked by the placeholder `'_`.

Fortunately the compiler is able to diagnose missing lifetimes with a good error message.

[ⓘ](https://docs.rs)

```
type Elided<'a> = &'a usize;
#[async_trait]
trait Test {
    async fn test(not_okay: Elided, okay: &usize) {}
}
```
```
error[E0726]: implicit elided lifetime not allowed here
 --> src/main.rs:9:29
  |
9 |     async fn test(not_okay: Elided, okay: &usize) {}
  |                             ^^^^^^- help: indicate the anonymous lifetime: `<'_>`
```
The fix is to name the lifetime or use `'_`.

```
#[async_trait]
trait Test {
    // either
    async fn test<'e>(elided: Elided<'e>) {}
    // or
    async fn test(elided: Elided<'_>) {}
}
```

---
